Dune sofa

Category Furniture
Brand Frighetto
Collection Frighetto
Year 2007

Modular sofa in various elements: right and left modules in different sizes, corners, supplemented with a sofa and an armchair. Beech and poplar structure with a spring system with elastic straps on metal frames. All padding is in polyurethane of several densities. The base is in chrome steel or lacquered steel.
